description: Different model profiles should preserve project-level audit coverage and unsupported project reporting for a polyglot repository.

lockedFields.reason: The polyglot fixture has one experimental Kotlin project, one supported JS project, and one experimental Python root.
The Kotlin, JavaScript, and Python projects are currently audited by registered adapters.
The Python root should no longer be reported as unsupported once the adapter is registered.
The repo should be reported as fully audited when all fixture roots have registered adapters.
The Kotlin, Python, and web projects each expose one deterministic test candidate.
The Python service root should stay explicitly reported as an audited project.

unexpectedVariations: partial audit coverage when all roots are supported
